quarterly_data.quarter: Crusoe press release: Crusoe Spark Liquid: 3.5MW modular AI factory (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Crusoe introduced Crusoe Spark Liquid, the sixth generation of its modular AI factory platform: prefabricated, closed-loop direct-liquid-cooled units engineered for NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 and NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 that support up to 3.5MW of compute per unit, built in Crusoe's factory and shipped ready to deploy, cutting deployment timelines from years to months to add Crusoe Cloud capacity closer to users for low-latency inference. Crusoe Spark is already deployed for Crusoe Cloud customers in production, such as Ollama.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 3.5MW of compute per unit; sixth generation
